user.title: OnStar China (安吉星)
user.description:
You need one captured login request from the OnStar **WeChat mini-program** (OnStar does not allow account/password login outside WeChat).

**How to get it:**
1. Capture mini-program traffic with Reqable / Charles / Stream
2. Open the mini-program → Me → sign out → sign in again (WeChat one-tap login)
3. Find the `oauth/wechatRegisterAndLogIn` request and copy:

• **User ID**: `idpUserId`, e.g. `LADPA017243106`
• **perm_token**: from the same login response (256 chars)
• **VIN**: 17 characters

**Service PIN (optional)**: locking / unlocking / remote start / horn & lights are *write* commands and require your OnStar service PIN (the one the app asks for). Leave it empty to use read-only vehicle data.

data_description.username: idpUserId field of the captured oauth/wechatRegisterAndLogIn request
data_description.perm_token: perm_token from the same login response; refreshes itself long-term
data_description.pin: Required for write commands only; leave empty for read-only sensors

reconfigure.title: Update OnStar credentials
reconfigure.description:
Update user ID / perm_token / VIN / service PIN.

perm_token cannot be left empty — capture a fresh one.

reauth_confirm.title: OnStar login expired
reauth_confirm.description:
The perm_token for {vin} is no longer valid (usually because the account signed in somewhere else).

Sign in again in the WeChat mini-program, capture the request and paste the new perm_token below.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid or expired perm_token / user ID — capture a fresh one
error.invalid_pin: Wrong service PIN — please check it (leave empty if you don't need write commands)
